value.rationale: The exact two-parameter sign surface B(D+2)=3 separates attracting-cycle and repelling-cycle onset for an ecological model already used to illustrate alternating interaction regimes. Contrasting pairs have identical Hopf frequency yet opposite nonlinear criticality, while the born cycles can be wholly antagonistic despite the model admitting a strict-mutualism region. These are motivated sharp classification and boundary facts, not a routine numerical sample or a claim that Hopf bifurcation itself is new.
